Method of Attack: Cross-Site Request Forgery (CSRF) leading to Stored Cross-Site Scripting (Stored XSS) attacks
Injection of malicious JavaScript code via specially crafted links
Abuse of ninja_forms_ajax_import_form AJAX function in legacy mode to import malicious forms
Replacement of all existing forms with malicious ones by manipulating formID $_POST parameter
Execution of malicious scripts in administrator and visitor browsers leading to site takeover or redirection
Impacted Systems: WordPress websites using Ninja Forms plugin versions up to 3.4.24.2
Attack Vector: Tricking WordPress administrators into clicking specially crafted links
Exploitation of AJAX import function without proper request origin validation
Use of administrator session to spoof requests and import malicious forms
